references.text: One thing I have asked of the Lord, that is what I seek: to dwell in the house of the Lord all the days of my life, to gaze upon the beauty of the Lord and to seek him in his temple.

And I saw the holy city, new Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven... And I heard a loud voice from the throne saying, "See, God's dwelling is with humanity, and he will dwell with them, and they shall be his people, and God himself will be with them."
For Christ did not enter a holy place made with hands, which is a copy of the true one, but into heaven itself, now to appear in the presence of God on our behalf.
I have built you an exalted house, a place where you may dwell forever.
